children: and South Africa-listed Sappi (SAP.J) on Thursday offered remedies in an effort to secure EU antitrust approval for their €1.42 billion ($1.6 billion) paper joint venture, the companies said on Thursday.

The remedies 'include capacity optimisation for the supply of certain paper grades in Europe' and 'certain commercial safeguards for customers, and investments in decarbonisation, electrification and energy efficiency', they said.
